per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: all 156 DBAASP assay/experiment rows and 3 literature links are source-verified against Table 1/Table 2/article metadata; 3 CAMP/dbAMP entry-text rows are preserved as source_conflict because they mix this DOI with database-only or other-PMID claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted with cautions: worker-2 recovered all 78 MIC rows from primary XML Table 2 with units, media, target species/strain, method context, and locators. No database-only activity row is treated as primary-source evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions: membrane conductance, insertion/self-association, and lipid interaction claims are source-located to model membrane assays and discussion; no unsupported intracellular-target or host-toxicity claim is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains extracted-with-gaps only because OA package/supplementary landing captures are not structured local supplements; those gaps are nonblocking for the repaired owner layers.

caution_findings.note: CAMP/dbAMP entry-text rows mix Table 2 MICs from this DOI with MBC/hemolysis/cell-line claims attributed to other PMIDs or database text; nonlocal claims are not promoted as this paper primary evidence.
Local supplementary .bin files are HTML landing-page captures; XML/PDF Table 2 and database snapshots resolve the owner-layer blockers.
Primary Table 2 spells Acinetobacter baumanii; linked database rows use Acinetobacter baumannii. Values/strains/media match and the spelling variant is preserved in raw_target_label.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework closed the prior worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 blockers for this paper. Table 2 supplies complete MIC rows; database conflicts are preserved instead of smoothed; final status is publication-grade with cautions, not clean acceptance.
